title: Digits by hand
description:
Print a number in decimal without `print_int`, by dividing by 10.

```
Number: 9031
9031
reversed digits: 1309
digit sum: 13
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Number: ", 0

        section .bss
buf:    resb    20

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        call    read_int
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: Point `rsi` at `buf + 20` and, for each digit, `dec rsi` / `mov [rsi], dl` after `add dl, '0'` (lesson 2.05).
Loop while the quotient is not zero; a `do ... while` shape (test at the end) prints `0` correctly.
requirements: Fill a small buffer from the end with `'0' + remainder`, then print it with one `write`.
Also print the digits reversed (in the order the divisions produce them) and their sum.
stretch: Print in any base from 2 to 16 read from the input.
